category: usenet provider (Dutch, unlimited flats and block accounts)

free_tier.stated: A 14-day trial period ('14 dagen proefperiode') is stated on the home page; its data allowance and whether it is charged are not stated on the page read.
free_tier.notes: The trial allowance is unverified: behind a sign-up.

egress.terms: Unlimited use on the four flat plans (10 Mbit, 24 Mbit, 100 Mbit and unlimited speed); block accounts sold separately

interface_detail: NNTP with free SSL and IPv6 support
chaining: Block accounts start from EUR 2.95 at unlimited speed with 50 connections and are the cheaper fill; the flats are speed-tiered.

limits.value: speed tiers 10 Mbit, 24 Mbit, 100 Mbit and unlimited speed
up to 50 connections; 10 on the 10 Mbit plan

limits_note: Flats from EUR 4.50 (10 Mbit), EUR 5.50 (24 Mbit), EUR 7.50 (100 Mbit) and EUR 9.50 (unlimited speed); blocks from EUR 2.95. The home page does not say whether the prices are monthly.
binding_note: Volume is unlimited on the flats; the speed tier and its connection count bound a month.

identity_cost.detail: The trial account is delivered by e-mail and is limited to residents of the Netherlands whose ISP peers with NL-IX, AMS-IX or private peers; one trial per address, no proxies or tunnels. After 14 days it converts to a paid account, paid by direct debit, iDEAL or PayPal; no card is named as a requirement. The trial form fields were not opened: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the vendor page read.
confidence_note: Prices, retention and the trial line are from the vendor home page read on 2026-11-03; the page is in Dutch.

evidence.proved: the cheapest flat, 10 Mbit, starts at EUR 4.50
the trial account is delivered to the user by e-mail; no card is named as a sign-up requirement
